quest.title: Witch's Revelation: Warden's Instruction
quest.description: You encounter Wriothesley at Barbeloth's fortune-telling booth...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Guide to Order x3

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Hello there, Lady Trismegistus.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Oh? Such perfect pronunciation... I can only assume we share a friend?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: A certain Miss Columbina recommended your services.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: A very unpredictable lady, that Miss Columbina. I'm sure your encounter must have been full of surprises.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: It sure was. "Unpredictable" is the perfect word.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance. The name's Wriothesley.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Le duc sous l'eau, in the flesh. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I wouldn't have thought such a great mage as yourself would have heard of me. I'm honored.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Or perhaps you saw my arrival in the stars, Lady Trismegistus?

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Hehe... Since we're already acquainted, let's dispense with the formalities. You can call me Barbeloth.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Then please, call me Wriothesley. This isn't official business, so there's no need for titles. I'm just a regular citizen of Fontaine enjoying some time off the clock.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I came across some freshly baked Conch Madeleines on my way here. I hear mages enjoy a good tea party. Please, take one.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Oh my, this is a very popular dessert at our parties.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: I've been here for quite some time now, and read the fortunes of a fair few people, but this is the first time anyone's come bearing gifts.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Thank you, Mr. Wriothesley. I'll make sure to share it with Alice and the others.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth?
dialogues.text: ...Is that my ears I feel tingling? Barbie! You simply have to save some for me!

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Don't let Nicole scarf the lot down before I get there — it's not like she hasn't done it before!

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Ahem! Yes, yes, I'll make sure she leaves some for you.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Honestly, you could have timed this better. Here I am, hoping to maintain the Hexenzirkel's dignity in front of our new friend...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: It's quite all right. Where's the harm? Powerful people don't have to be serious all the time. Everyone's entitled to a little personality.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Exactly! As a matter of fact, optimism and cheerfulness are core entry requirements of the Hexenzirkel.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: This is the first I've heard of it...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: It's a new rule I just came up with! The Hexenzirkel is supposed to bring joy to the world. It's only natural that we're cheerful and optimistic!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Speaking only for myself, I support everyone enjoying life however they please — provided no laws are broken, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: That's a provision you might struggle to get Alice to stick to...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Oh my, well this is a concern.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Hah, you two do realize I'm still here, right!?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Besides, I'm not going to do anything criminal in front of the Administrator of the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: ...And even if I was, I imagine your rooms are more spacious than the Knights of Favonius's solitary confinement room. Isn't that right, Mr. Wriothesley?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Haha! As though a mere solitary confinement room could hold a legendary mage such as yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I'm sure Lady Alice has willingly accepted her punishment, no doubt due to her humility and unimpeachable trustworthiness.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Exactly — you couldn't be more right!

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Please stop, Mr. Wriothesley. You really shouldn't encourage her.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Once she's in a good mood, there's no telling what Alice might do.

choices.text: I know exactly what you mean.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's right! {NICKNAME}'s the Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius, y'know! No talking bad about the solitary confinement room behind its back, hehe...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Does that mean it's up to the Honorary Knight to chase down escaped mages? That would make for a wonderful show. Please be sure to invite me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You just love watching the drama unfold!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, Paimon didn't expect you to come here by yourself, Wriothesley. That saves us a trip underwater to fetch you!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This must be the power of divination.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: Ah, speaking of which, it's about time we got down to business.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: Mr. Wriothesley, whether out of respect for Miss Columbina or as thanks for your confectionery, please draw a Lunar Arcanum.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: Perhaps a gift from fate lies hidden within.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Does that count as a prophecy?

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: You could say that.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Then no Fontainian would fail to take it seriously.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Having said how seriously he would take it, Wriothesley goes straight for the topmost card...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'm not too familiar with these cards. This one appears to be...

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: The upright Emperor...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: You seem lost for words... Is this card bad? There's no need to worry, I can handle whatever you tell me.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: ...Quite the opposite. This card signifies eternal dominion and unshakable authority.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: If this represents your future, then you have already reached your destination.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: But... Hehe, your fate keeps rolling forward, forever changing, which can only mean...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Perhaps it's not the person who changes, but their environment?

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: Mmhmm... At least for now, such a tendency does seem to exist.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Then I guess I can be a bit more confident in my intuition from now on.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I previously visited Nod-Krai on official business and gained quite a bit of insight. Since then, I can't help but keep an eye on the local news.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Then, one night, as I was gazing at an unusually bright moon, I found myself thinking that the world is changing.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: The world is constantly changing, but with the introduction of such huge variables, we must all be prepared to face the unknown.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: That said, judging by the card you picked, you shouldn't have much to worry about. No matter how your environment changes, you have the means to either adapt or resist.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Such wonderful news! Looks like I didn't take that punch for nothing...

choices.text: It was a punch filled with beautiful wishes.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: As a matter of curiosity, I have a somewhat presumptuous question to ask... I hope you don't mind...

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: How sly! You're deliberately trying to pique our curiosity, Mr. Wriothesley! Now, we have no choice but to insist that you ask.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Then permit me to be frank.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I've always wondered... How exactly does a prophecy ensure its own fulfillment?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Take me, for example. My reading says I'll remain stable.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But what if, after hearing this prophecy, a sudden rebellious urge takes hold, and I immediately do something impulsive? What would happen then?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: For example, what if...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You blew up the Fortress of Meropide?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Sure, let's go with that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you really dragging that back up again!?

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Oooh!

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: No, don't you even...

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Ahaha! What a happy coincidence! I just so happen to know a very skilled explosives expert. I can't recommend her highly enough.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: But then the Honorary Knight will surely act as her guardian, stepping in at the critical moment to stop anything bad from happening!

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: ...And that is how the prophecy is fulfilled.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: She sounds like quite the destructive force.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And cute. Very cute.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, are we talking about Klee!? Wriothesley probably doesn't know that Klee is Alice's daughter, right?

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Well, actually, I think you'll find her full title is Daughter of the Great Adventurer of the Realms, Dodo-King, Defender of Old Mondstadt...

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: We don't have time for all that!

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Fine... She's the Most Adorable Child of Alice, the Dodo-King, the Veritable Spark Knight, Klee!

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Honestly, we really should go back to my original plan and throw a fabulous party for everyone where I can introduce you all properly.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: That way, when Klee goes to Fontaine, she'll have plenty of new friends to drink tea with.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: That sounds like a wonderful plan. I'm looking forward to it already.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: After all, it's not like I can turn down a good pot of tea.

choices.text: Good fortune comes to those who survive great disasters.
Please show some respect for the solitary confinement room.
